card.name: Body size and age in dosing criteria
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and number pieces right after body-size or age terms (BMI, weight, aged, pre-pregnancy body) or inside year and weight-formula numbers. It also fires on small words in 'screen for renal impairment by obtaining a history'.

modes.label: After BMI or age
modes.description: The space or symbol that follows BMI, a patient age range, or a year, before the number.

modes.label: Inside numbers in formulas and tables
modes.description: Digits or decimal points inside years, table values or creatinine-clearance formulas.

modes.label: Renal screening phrase
modes.description: Words in 'screen all patients for renal impairment by obtaining a history'.
modes.example: Screen all patients for renal dysfunction by<< obtaining>> a history and/or laboratory tests.
